import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Transaction Amount by Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=len(df['transaction_type'].unique()))
sns.barplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=ax1, palette=colors)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax1.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
for i, v in enumerate(df.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].mean()):
    ax1.text(i, v + 10, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Transaction Distribution by Hour
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
hour_counts = df['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax2.bar(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, color='steelblue', edgecolor='navy')
ax2.set_title('Transactions by Hour of Day')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax2.set_xticks(df['hour_of_day'].unique())

# Plot 3: Transaction Type Distribution (Pie Chart)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
type_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
explode = [0.05] * len(type_counts)
ax3.pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        explode=explode, colors=colors, shadow=True)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution')

# Plot 4: Amount vs Hour of Day (Scatter with Transaction Type)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for i, trans_type in enumerate(df['transaction_type'].unique()):
    subset = df[df['transaction_type'] == trans_type]
    ax4.scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
                label=trans_type, s=100, alpha=0.7, c=[colors[i]])
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day')
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
ax4.legend(title='Transaction Type')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
